Automotive Technology.text:
Core Courses: Auto Engine Performance, Heating & Air Conditioning Systems, Manual Transmissions, Automatic Transmissions, Engine Repair & Testing, Suspension & Steering, Braking Systems, Electrical Systems, Fabrication Basics, Alternative Energy.

General Education Courses: Core Competencies, Computer Concepts (MS Word & Excel), Technical Math, Business Management, Customer Service, Job Search.

Equipment used during course of study: Computerized Automotive Information System, Four-wheel Computerized Alignment Machine, Computerized Wheel Balancer, Articulating Arm Tire Machine, Brake Lathe, Diagnostic Computer Scanners, Fuel Injection Test Equipment, Basic Engine Testing Tools, Specialized Automatic Transmission Tools, Electronic Testing Tools and Meters, and Air Conditioning Recovery and Recharging Equipment.

Building Technology.text:
Focus of Studies and Core Competencies: Residential construction techniques and home remodeling techniques, an in-depth understanding of the common practices and materials used in the industry, possess the ability to safely operate tools and equipment in the construction industry in order to safely complete a large array of construction projects.

Skills studied during course work: Trim work, installing doors and windows, framing, lite electrical and plumbing, reading blueprints, drywall, masonry, roofing, siding, and tool safety.

General Education Courses: Business Management & Law, Computers & Job Search (MS Word & Excel), Core Competencies, Job Search, Applied Math, Customer Service, Technical Math, Personal Finance.

Combination Welding.text:
Core Courses: Welding Fabrication, Welding Mathematics, Oxy Fuel Cutting, SMAW, GMAW, GTAW, Non-Ferrous Welding, FCAW, Plasma & Arc Cutting, Pipe & Welding Blueprint Reading, MIG/TIG/Stick Pipe Welding.

Positions include: 1G, 2G, 3G, 4G Plate, 1G, 2G, 5G, 6G Pipe, 1F, 2F, 3F, 4F Plate, and 1F, 2F, 4F, 5F, 6F Pipe to plate.

Equipment used during course of study: Electric Arc Welders, Gas Metal Arc Welders, Dual Shield Flux Core Arc Welders, Gas Tungsten Arc Welders, Portable and Semi-automatic Burning Equipment, Carbon and Plasma Arc Cutting Equipment, Hydraulic Shears, Horizontal Band Saw, Hand Operated Grinders, and Beveller.

General Education Courses: Career Prep & Personal Finance (MS Word).

Diesel and Heavy Equipment Repair Techno.text:
Course work includes the following: Diagnosis, Troubleshooting, Disassembly, and Repair of Diesel Engines, including replacement of pistons, bearings, gears, valves, and bushings and installation of ignition systems.

Replacement of Steering and Suspension Components; Repair and Replacement of Transmissions and Parts; Diagnosis of Problems and Replacement of Chassis Assemblies; Repair and Replacement of Pneumatic and Hydraulic Brakes.

Entry Level Competency in the Following Areas: Diesel Engine Repair; Diesel Engine Performance; Engine Electronics; Steering and Suspension; Power Trains; Hydraulic and Pneumatic Brakes; DC Electrical Systems; CAT, Cummins and Detroit Engines; Prints, Schematics and Fabrication; Precision Measuring; Proprietary Information Systems.

General Education Courses include the following: Strategies for Success; Customer Service; Computer Concepts; Job Search; Business Management; Personal Finance; Basic Math; Technical Math, including Basic and Intermediate Algebra; Applied Math, including Geometry and Trigonometry.

Shop and Lab Training: Repairs on Semi-Tractors, Trailers and Diesel Engines utilizing the following equipment: Diagnostic Computer Scanners and Computerized Information Systems; Fuel Injection Test Equipment; Basic Engine Testing Tools; Specialized Transmission Tools; Electronic Circuit Testing Tools and Meters.

Electrical Technology.text:
Core Classes: Electricity, Blueprint Reading, Construction Wiring, Machine Control, Machine Control Lab, Electrical Motors, Residential Circuitry, Commercial Circuitry, Services & Conduit, NEC Residential, AC/DC Power, Programmable Controllers, Telecommunications, Solid State, Electronic Control.

General Education Classes: Core Competencies, Tech Math, Applied Math, Job Search, Foundations in Personal Finance, Business Management, including Business Law, Computer Concepts, including MS Word and Excel.

Equipment used during course of study: Meters, Conduit Benders, All Phases of Motor Control Equipment, 3-Phase Motors, Single Phase Motors, Assorted Residential, Commercial and Industrial Components, Oscilloscope, and Programmable Logic Controllers.

Electrical and Industrial Maintenance.text:
Graduates demonstrate skills in the areas of commercial and industrial electricity, welding, HVAC, pneumatics, hydraulics, gaskets and seals, pumps, plumbing, equipment maintenance, forklift operation, wind power generation and solar power, and familiarity with safety procedures and tools used in an industrial setting.

Equipment Used: Conduit Bending Equipment, Motor Controls, Electric Motors, Test Meters, Service Panels, Freezers and Refrigerators, Air Conditioners, Heating Systems, Precision Measuring Tools, Pneumatic Equipment, Hydraulic Equipment, Pumps, Valves, Plumbing Tools, Plumbing Fixtures, Arc and MIG Welders, Cutting Torches.

Core Courses: Essentials of Electricity; Fluid Control; Welding & Cutting; Combination Welding; Plumbing, Brazing & Fusion; Industrial Mechanics I; Industrial Mechanics II; Electrical Services; Motors & Electric Power I; Motors & Electric Power II; PLCs; Basic Rigging; Safety & Tools; HVAC.

General Education Courses: Core Competencies; Technical Math; Job Search; Applied Math; Computer Concepts, including MS Word and Excel.

Machinist and CNC Manufacturing.text:
Core Courses: Set-up and programming of C.N.C. mill using FANUC controls and C.N.C. lathe using HAAS controls, introduction to BobCAD, Conversational Programming, Set-up and Operation of Manual Lathes and Mills, Blueprint Reading, including dimensional blueprint reading, Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing, and Fabrication Basics.

General Education Courses: Business Management, Business Law, Basic through Advanced Shop Mathematics, Trigonometry, Computer Concepts, including MS Word and Excel, Job Search and Strategies for Success.

Equipment used during course of study: Horizontal and Vertical Band Saw, Milling Machines, Lathes, Hydraulic Presses, Drill Presses, Fixtures, Precision Measuring Instruments, FANUC-Control Vertical Mill, Haas TL-1 CNC Lathe, Manual Surface Grinder, and Pedestal Grinders.

Motorcycle and Power Equipment Technolog.text:
Course work includes the following: Hydraulics, Small Engine Operation, Small Engine Maintenance, Intro to Motorcycles, Motorcycle Basics, Electrical Fundamentals, Electrical System Analysis, Fuel Systems, Fuel System Analysis, Drive Trains, Motorcycle Repair, Motorcycle Diagnostics, Small Engine Repair, Small Engine Performance, Power Equipment Analysis.

Entry Level Competency in the Following Areas: Electrical diagnostics; diagnose, troubleshoot, and disassemble small engines; replace pistons, bearings, gears, valves and bushings; install ignition systems; multi-point vehicle service and replace steering and suspension components; replace clutches, transmissions and parts; diagnose problems with and maintain carbureted and fuel injection systems; disassemble and replace hydraulic brakes; perform necessary maintenance and checks on various pieces of equipment.

General Education Courses include the following: Strategies for Success; Customer Service; Computer Concepts; Job Search; Business Management; Personal Finance; Basic Math; Technical Math, including Basic and Intermediate Algebra; Applied Math, including Geometry and Trigonometry.

Shop and Lab Training on: Electrical multi-meter with tachometer and temperature probe, tire machine, boring bars, valve cutting tools.

Refrigeration and AC Technology.text:
Core Courses: Refrigeration Fundamentals, Refrigeration Processes, Electricity, Electrical Circuitry, Climate Control, Heating Systems, Commercial Refrigeration, Commercial Applications, Sheet Metal Basics, Air Distribution Systems, A/C & Heat Pumps, including class and lab, Manual J.

General Education Courses: Business Management, Business Law, Computer Concepts, including MS Word and Excel, Basic Math, Job Search, Strategies for Success, Applied Math, Customer Service, Technical Math.

Equipment used during course of study: Commercial Walk-In Coolers and Freezers, Commercial Reach-In Coolers and Freezers, Ice-Making Machines, Heat Pumps, Central A/C, High-, Medium- and Low-Efficiency Gas Furnaces, Oil and Electric Furnaces, Two-Stage and Modulating Furnaces, Hydronic Systems, Sheet Metal Fabrication Brakes, Shears and Roll Formers.

Refrigeration and Climate Control.text:
Core Courses: Refrigeration Fundamentals, Refrigeration Processes, Electricity, Electrical Circuitry, Climate Control, Heating Systems, Commercial Refrigeration, Commercial Applications, Air Distribution Systems, A/C & Heat Pumps, including class and lab, Manual J.

General Education Courses: Computer Concepts, including MS Word and Excel, Basic Math, Job Search, Strategies for Success, Applied Math, Customer Service, Technical Math.

Equipment used during course of study: Commercial Walk-In Coolers and Freezers, Commercial Reach-In Coolers and Freezers, Ice-Making Machines, Heat Pumps, Central A/C, High-, Medium- and Low-Efficiency Gas Furnaces, Oil and Electric Furnaces, Two-Stage and Modulating Furnaces.
